release_notes: Added 02-research/06-guilt-spiral-and-supportive-language.md with named lived-experience sources, surfaced in the in-app Research page

Added a research-backed governing voice principle applied app-wide: gentle short validating statements, permission without pressure or commentary, no praise for basic communication, no narrating the person's psychology back to them
Reconnect screen finalised to three actions (Send, Edit, Personalise); Conversations hidden until triggered, then a gentle gate prompt
Finalised Reconnect status/gate copy in the new voice; updated MVP requirements to match
Clarified the Reconnect gate appears only after Send; Personalise always skips it and goes straight into Conversations
Clarified Going Quiet gives each selected Circle its own message box when more than one is chosen, rather than one shared box
Added 06-privacy-security/04-content-retention.md resolving the open retention-window question as a three-tier model, and a native-input-assistance accessibility requirement
Corrected Reconnect's gate: "Not now" returns to Home/Post-Reconnect, not straight to Reconnected, resolving a contradiction with the journey overview
